Lab Data - DIC and pH Calculate 
```{r}

library(readxl)
library(ldeomeb)

dic <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Users/henryholm/OneDrive - Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution/Desktop/ORCC/Copy of HurleyS 250311 ORCC_250303 P240998.xlsx",sheet = 2)
dic2 <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Users/henryholm/OneDrive - Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution/Desktop/ORCC/HurleyS 250730 DIP ORCC P262351.xlsx",sheet = 2)

# load pH plate data
loc <- "C:/Users/henryholm/OneDrive - Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution/Desktop/ORCC/"
loc <- paste0(loc, c("ORCC_pH_Complete_Book.xlsx", "ORCC_pH_Complete_Book_preJan13th.xlsx"))
# import data from all sheets and combine
all_sheets <- lapply(loc, function(loc) {
  # Get all sheet names
  sheet_names <- excel_sheets(loc)

  # Read each sheet into a named list of data.frames
  all_sheets <- lapply(sheet_names, read_excel, path = loc)
  names(all_sheets) <- sheet_names
  return(all_sheets)
}) %>%
  list_flatten()

# drop any empty sheets
all_sheets <- all_sheets[!sapply(all_sheets, is_empty)]

# drop sheets without name data one without names
all_sheets <- all_sheets[which(!names(all_sheets) %in% c("Jan_1_22_2025","Apr_15_25"))]

ph_spec <- map(all_sheets, function(x){x %>% data.frame() %>% ldeomeb::tidyplate()},.progress = T) 

# drop this bad replicate
dic2 <- dic2[which(!dic2$`Sample ID` == "Tpsu_O417_A"),]

dic <- bind_rows(dic,dic2)

loc <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16Oq4psIy7DFOsbAWLwy2RkPCYLFqkRjJey-ki3iN2SQ/edit"

# import
curves <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(loc,sheet = "Curves")
cultures <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(loc,sheet = "Cultures")
samples <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(loc,sheet = "Samples")

ph_spec <- ph_spec %>%
  map(~ .x$plates %>%
        subset(!is.na(value) | !is.na(names)) %>%
        calc_plate(tidyplate = .,pairs = .x$pairs),
      .progress = T) %>%
  bind_rows()

# fix names
ph_spec$`Culture_ID#` <- ph_spec$names %>%
  str_replace(pattern = "tpsu",replacement = "T_pseudo") %>%
  str_replace(pattern = "Tpsu",replacement = "T_pseudo") %>%
  str_replace(pattern = "7002",replacement = "Syn_7002") %>%
  str_replace(pattern = "Ehux",replacement = "E_huxleyi") %>%
  str_replace(pattern = "8102",replacement = "Syn_8102") %>%
  str_replace(pattern = "Syn_Syn",replacement = "Syn")

# create same date columns for matching
curves$date <- date(curves$Meaurement_DateTime)
ph_spec$date <- date(ph_spec$`Average Start Time`)

#rename and match
ph_spec <- ph_spec %>% rename(pH_total_spec = pH)
curves <- left_join(curves,ph_spec,by = join_by(`Culture_ID#`,date))

dic$`Culture_ID#` <- dic$`Sample ID Offical`

joined <- left_join(dic,curves)

joined <- samples %>%
          subset(!duplicated(`Sample Name`)) %>% 
  select(`Sample Name`,`Harvest Type`) %>%
  left_join(joined,.,by = join_by(`Sample ID Offical` == `Sample Name`))

for (i in seq_along(joined$pH_volt)) {
  if (is.na(joined[i, "pH_temp"])) {
    joined[i, "pH_total_volt"] <- NA
  } else {
    joined[i, "pH_total_volt"] <- seacarb::pH(
      Ex = joined[i, "pH_volt"],
      Etris = joined[i, "pH_std_volt"],
      T = joined[i, "pH_temp"]
    )
  }
}

lm(joined$pH_total_volt ~ joined$pH_NIST)

ggplot(joined,aes(pH_total_volt,pH_NIST)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1,intercept = 0.2,linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal()

joined %>% subset(pH_total_volt > 6) %>% # drop one outlier
ggplot(aes(pH_total_volt)) +
  geom_density(aes(fill = Condition)) 

joined %>% subset(pH_total_volt > 6) %>% 
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(pH_total_volt))

joined %>% select(`Culture_ID#`,Meaurement_DateTime,pH_total_volt,pH_total_spec) %>%
  subset(complete.cases(.)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(pH_total_spec,pH_total_volt)) +
  geom_abline(aes(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "1:1 Line",color = "1:1 Line"), size =0.75) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm",alpha = 0.1) +
  ggpubr::stat_regline_equation() +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_point(shape = 1) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid",'dotted',"solid")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red","black","black")) +
  labs(x = "pH Total Scale (Voltage Based)",
       y = "pH Total Scale (m-cresol)",
       linetype = "", color = ""
       )

joined <- joined %>% subset(complete.cases(pH_total_volt,`DIC (mM)`,Temp.nominal))

curves %>% subset(pH_NIST > 5 & pH_NIST < 10) %>%
  group_by(Incubator.CO2.ppm.nominal) %>%
  summarise(`Total pH` = mean(pH_NIST-0.23))

### full carb calc
joined <- pyco2$sys(
  par1      = joined$pH_total_volt,
  par2      = joined$`DIC (mM)`/1.0265/1e3, #measured density w. 
  par1_type = 3L,
  par2_type = 2L,
  salinity  = 35,
  opt_pH_scale = 1,
  temperature = joined$Temp.nominal,
  pressure  = 0,
  opt_k_carbonic = 10,
  opt_k_bisulfate = 1,
  opt_total_borate =1,
  opt_k_fluoride = 1
) %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  rename_with(~ paste0("pyco2sys_", .)) %>%
  cbind(joined,.)
  
joined <- seacarb::carbfull(flag = 9,
                        var1 = joined$pH_total_volt,
                        var2 = joined$`DIC (mM)`/1.0265/1e3,
                        T = joined$Temp.nominal,
                        S = 35,
                        pHscale = "T",
                        k1k2 = "l", ks = "d", kf = "dg" # match PyCO2sys settings
                        ) %>% 
  rename_with(~ paste0("seacarb_", .)) %>%
  cbind(joined,.)

plot((joined$seacarb_CO2-joined$pyco2sys_CO2)*1e6)
plot((joined$seacarb_HCO3-joined$pyco2sys_HCO3)*1e6)

df <- stringr::str_split(joined$`Culture_ID#`,pattern = "_",simplify = TRUE)
  
joined$sp <- paste(df[,1],df[,2],sep = "_")

# just looking at Ehux and Tpsu for this paper
joined <- joined %>% subset(Name %in% c("Ehux", "Tpsu"))

joined %>% 
  group_by(Incubator.CO2.ppm.nominal) %>%
  summarise(`mean pCO2 (calculated)` = mean(seacarb_pCO2),
            `sd pCO2 (calculated)` = sd(seacarb_pCO2))

r <- joined %>%
    subset(Blank %in% c("Sample_Final") & !sp %in% c("NA_","7002")) %>%
    group_by(`Sample ID Offical`,Blank,Incubator.CO2.ppm.nominal,Name,`Harvest Type`,Medium) %>%
    summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      .fns = list(
        mean = ~mean(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE),
        sd   = ~sd(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  )
r$Name <- unlist(r$Name)

s <- joined %>%
    subset(Blank %in% c("Sample_Final") & !sp %in% c("NA_","7002")) %>%
    group_by(Incubator.CO2.ppm.nominal,Name) %>%
    summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      .fns = list(
        mean = ~mean(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE),
        sd   = ~sd(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  )

s$Name <- unlist(s$Name)


b <- joined %>%
  group_by(`Sample ID Offical`) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = `Growth Time Nominal (hours)`,n = 1,with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  subset(Blank %in% c("Blank_Initial") & sp != "NA_") %>% group_by(Name,Condition) %>%
    summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      .fns = list(
        mean = ~mean(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE),
        sd   = ~sd(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  )

b$Name <- unlist(b$Name)

t <- joined %>%
  subset(sp != "NA_") %>%
  group_by(Name,Incubator.CO2.ppm.nominal) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      .fns = list(
        mean = ~mean(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE),
        sd   = ~sd(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  )
t$Name <- unlist(t$Name)

a <- joined %>%
  subset(sp != "NA_" & Name != "7002") %>%
   group_by(Incubator.CO2.ppm.nominal) %>%
    summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      .fns = list(
        mean = ~mean(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE),
        sd   = ~sd(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(Name = "All Sp")

ab <- joined %>%
  group_by(Incubator.CO2.ppm.nominal) %>%
  subset(Blank %in% c("Blank_Initial") & !sp %in% c("NA_","7002")) %>%
  #group_by(Incubator.CO2.ppm.nominal,Name) %>%
    summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      .fns = list(
        mean = ~mean(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE),
        sd   = ~sd(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  )%>%
  mutate(Name = "All Sp")
ab$Name <- unlist(ab$Name)

as <- joined %>%
  group_by(`Sample ID Offical`) |>
  subset(Blank %in% c("Sample_Final")) %>%
  slice_max(`Growth Time Nominal (hours)`, n = 1) %>%
  group_by(Incubator.CO2.ppm.nominal) %>%
    summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      .fns = list(
        mean = ~mean(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE),
        sd   = ~sd(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  )%>%
  mutate(Name = "All Sp")

as$Name <- unlist(as$Name)

joined %>%
  group_by(`Sample ID Offical`,Blank) %>%
    summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      .fns = list(
        mean = ~mean(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE),
        sd   = ~sd(unique(.x), na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  )
  

lab <- bind_rows(list(reps = r,
                      samples = s, blanks = b, total = t, all = a, all_blank = ab, all_sample = as),.id = 'samp_group') 

current <- joined %>%
  subset(Name != "7002") 

lab[which(lab$Condition == "Ambient"),"temp"] <- 22
lab[which(lab$Condition == "1135ppm"),"temp"] <- 25.3

remove(df,s,t,b,ab,as,r)

```
